statements.notes: Throughout most of recorded history, our ancestors utilized whole-animal nutrition, where the cartilaginous tissue of grass-fed pastured animals was frequently consumed in traditional diets. Rich in bioactive compounds including Undenatured Type II Collagen and chondroitin sulfate. Enviromedica Cartilage Collagen provides a concentrated matrix of naturally occurring nutrients in their correct physiological ratios.
This ancient nutritional powerhouse place a fundamental role in supporting healthy joints, cartilage, and immune function.

Our promise
Premium foundational products to support the body's ancestral biology.

Enviromedica Cartilage Collagen is sourced exclusively from grass-fed livestock raised on the rich open pastures of New Zealand, where animal husbandry practices are globally considered as second to none. Fresh tracheal cartilage is gently freeze-dried to preserve biological activity and nutrient content.
These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

Grass-fed, New Zealand pasture-raised
Whole Food nutritional support
For cartilage, joint, and immune health
Contains no dairy, wheat, yeast, gluten, corn, sugar, soy, shellfish, tree nuts, or preservatives. Made without stearates, fillers, binders, flow agents, or additives of any kind.
Suggested use: Take 4 capsules per day with or without food, or as recommended by your healthcare professional.
